source.title: Mechanical Repair Kits
source.objective:
ProgressThe biggest reason I can't open up my booth is that... everything's broken!  I need mechanical repair kits to fix all this stuff!

Can you bring me those kits, <name>?  I'll trade you... kits for Darkmoon Faire tickets.  What do you say?
source.completion:
Thank you!  Now I can get to fixing things.

It's going to take a lot of repair kits and a lot of late nights to get everything in working order.  Sometimes I think it'd be better to get back to my roots and restart my career as a headhunter, but... the Faire has been good to me.

Take these tickets, <name>, and have fun!
